req.title: Reject player with duplicate squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when the squadNumber in a new player already belongs to another player.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-008 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when a POST /players/ request carries a squadNumber already owned by another player. The test suite covers: (1) positive path — creating a player with a genuinely new squad number succeeds with HTTP 201; (2) negative path — posting a player whose squad number duplicates an existing pre-loaded row returns exactly HTTP 409 with the documented detail string; (3) boundary path — squad number 26 is the last pre-loaded value (taken), squad number 27 is the first free value; tests at both boundaries confirm the off-by-one edge and catch constant/comparison mutations; (4) decision-table path — verifies that the conflict check is independent of all other fields (only squad_number matters); (5) state-transition path — first POST creates a player (201), second POST with the same squad number returns 409, confirming the state machine transitions correctly and is not idempotent on conflict.

tests.name: test_post_player_unique_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains exactly 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squadNumber=27
expected: Response body contains the created player with squadNumber=27
Response body contains a non-null id (UUID)
trace: R-PLAYER-008 — happy path: unique squad number must succeed
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_unique_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

tests.name: test_post_player_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409
preconditions: Database contains a player with squadNumber=10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squadNumber=10 (already taken)
expected: Response detail contains 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-008 — error pathway: duplicate squadNumber must yield 409
tests.executable:
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409():

tests.name: test_post_player_state_transition_create_then_duplicate
preconditions: Squad number 28 is not taken in the pre-loaded database
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=28 — expect 201 (state: player created)
POST /players/ again with squadNumber=28 — expect 409 (state: conflict detected)
expected: Second POST detail is exactly 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-008 — STC: system transitions from 'no player' to 'player exists'; second POST must detect the new state and return 409
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_state_transition_create_then_duplicate():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "lastName": "Transition",
        "squadNumber": 28,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r1 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert body1["squadNumber"] == 28

    r2 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r2.status_code == 409
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert body2["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

tests.name: test_post_player_duplicate_does_not_return_201_or_500
preconditions: Database contains a player with squadNumber=7 (Ishaan Iyer)
expected: Status code is not 201, not 200, not 500
trace: R-PLAYER-008 — NEG: ensures the implementation does not silently succeed or crash on duplicate
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_duplicate_does_not_return_201_or_500():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Wrong",
        "lastName": "Return",
        "squadNumber": 7,
        "position": "Centre-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 409
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 500
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert body["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."
